result.finding: 8 runtime Java Maven dependencies managed via pom.xml with Spring Boot 2.7.18 as parent BOM. Dependencies are resolved and bundled into a Spring Boot fat JAR during the Docker multi-stage build.
evidence: Dockerfile: COPY pom.xml . and RUN mvn dependency:go-offline -B (layer caching for dependencies)
Dockerfile: COPY src ./src and RUN mvn clean package -DskipTests (builds fat JAR)
pom.xml: 8 runtime/compile scope dependencies + 2 test-only dependencies
All dependencies bundled into app.jar (Spring Boot fat JAR, BOOT-INF/lib/)
values: Runtime dependencies (8): spring-boot-starter-web, spring-boot-starter-thymeleaf, spring-boot-starter-data-jpa, ojdbc8, spring-boot-starter-validation, commons-io:2.11.0, spring-boot-starter-json, spring-boot-devtools (optional)
Packaging: Spring Boot fat JAR (all dependencies bundled)
